The displayed representative is among the accepted families.

value.rationale: This is the natural smallest nontrivial exact case of the three-row strength-three extremal function studied in the literature. Earlier work explicitly supplies a six-column construction and construction tables, while the new result closes the upper bound and classifies all maxima. The one-orbit statement is structural rather than a routine numerical increment and gives a canonical base case for testing constructions and equivalence-reduction methods.
